card.name: Course outcome lists in syllabi
card.fires_on: Punctuation and list dashes inside university course descriptions, especially in learning-outcome bullet lists for education or math courses. It also fires on a few nearby words such as 'should' and 'Special'.

modes.label: Bullet dashes
modes.description: The dash that starts an item in a list of skills or outcomes the student will show.
modes.example: Practical and/or professional skills <<->> demonstrate, through written assignments and an end

modes.label: Sentence-ending punctuation
modes.description: Periods or commas closing an outcome item or a heading phrase, just before the next list item or section.
modes.example: identify areas for improving your own learning, further training and workplace performance<<. >>Teaching, learning and assessment methods

modes.label: Course-info words
modes.description: Words in course headers or outcome intros such as 'Special' fee or 'students should'.
modes.example: Upon successful completion students<< should>> be able to: • Understand the theoretical

card.plain: It lights up on the dashes and full stops that structure lists of learning outcomes in course descriptions.
